name: db-conn-mcp
description: Safely query your databases (PostgreSQL) with AI agents — native read-only enforcement, sanitized errors, no DSN leaks.
long_description: A dead-simple, self-hosted MCP server for securely querying databases via AI agents. A database marked read is enforced read-only by PostgreSQL itself; writes are gated mode -> yolo -> user_consent. DSNs are never logged or returned. Distributed on PyPI and launched here via uvx.

connections_path.title: connections.json path
connections_path.description: Path to your connections.json. Create it first with `db-conn-mcp setup`. Your DSN stays local and is never sent anywhere.
